label: DisasterReady India - Mobile Relief Supplies Request
title: DisasterReady India - Mobile Relief Supplies Request
prompt: Mobile Relief Supplies Request & Confirmation (R1-R7 /supplies): Citizen relief intake form Step 1 of 7 "What urgent supplies do you need?". 56px large toggle tiles with 2px line icons: Drinking Water, Food Packets, Medicine Kits, Blankets, Tents, Baby Food, Sanitation Kits. Helper toggle "I am requesting on behalf of another person". People count stepper with vulnerable care counts (Elderly, Infants, Pregnant). Also displays verified Request Token box: "DR-1042", offline SMS fallback format payload (`DRI#SOS#MOHANPUR#4P#WTR+MED#9876543210`) with one-tap copy button, and Courier OTP delivery code preview (4829) with plain instructions. Fixed clear spacing for emergency bar.
